First, note the given date: 05-02-1137 (likely DD-MM-YYYY format, i.e., 5 February 1137).  
Subtract 25 weeks and 7 days → total days = (25 × 7) + 7 = 175 + 7 = 182 days.  

182 days before 5 February 1137:  
1137 is a common year (not divisible by 4 in the Gregorian calendar, but Gregorian rules apply per instructions).  
Go back 182 days:  
From 5 Feb back 5 days → 31 Jan 1137.  
From 31 Jan back 31 days → 31 Dec 1136.  
From 31 Dec 1136 back remaining 182 - 5 - 31 = 146 days.  

December 1136 has 31 days, November 30, October 31, September 30, August 31, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 29? 1136 is a leap year (divisible by 4) in the Gregorian proleptic sense? 1136 divisible by 4 → yes, leap year.  

Count back from 31 Dec 1136:  
Dec: 0 days (already at 31 Dec)  
Nov: 30 days → 146 - 30 = 116 left, date now 1 Dec 1136.  
Oct: 31 days → 116 - 31 = 85 left, date now 1 Nov 1136.  
Sep: 30 days → 85 - 30 = 55 left, date now 1 Oct 1136.  
Aug: 31 days → 55 - 31 = 24 left, date now 1 Sep 1136.  
Jul: 31 days → but only need 24 days back from 1 Sep 1136.  
From 1 Sep back 1 day → 31 Aug. Back 24 days total from 1 Sep means date = 1 Sep - 24 days = 31 Aug - 23 days = 8 Aug 1136.
